summary: Cardiff Oncology filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 8,571,429 common shares with warrants at $1.05/unit to institutional investors and 721,649 shares with warrants at $1.455/unit to insiders, raising ~$10.1M gross ($9.35M net after 7% placement agent fee). The warrants have a $1.31 ($1.33 insider) exercise price, exercisable six months post-closing subject to a charter amendment to increase authorized shares, requiring a proxy filing within 45 days and subsequent meetings until approved. H.C. Wainwright is placement agent. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown for working capital, not a special situation.
